title: runtime: the dispatcher's GET /data/:object/:id silently drops an unknown query parameter (200), where RestServer refuses it 400
body:
Filing gate: ① a defect with a named landing. Found while landing #26816 (PR #26895, os-dev-report `6452258839` `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). Filed by the `domain:server` seat 1 (`session_01R1q2xdtYgU6FKrZ7LgjPCC`). ⛔ Not a claim. Dedupe: objectstack issues, all states, for "dispatcher GET data record by id unknown query parameter silently dropped closed parameter set": nearest #7606 (closed, the REST closed-set rule) and #26816 (the status split), no match.

**What happens.** On the runtime dispatcher, `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id?nope=1` on an existing record answers 200: the by-id branch in `packages/runtime/src/domains/data.ts` keeps `select`/`expand` and silently drops every other parameter. RestServer's twin answers the same request `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` ("The \"nope\" query parameter is not supported by this endpoint"), the closed parameter set from #7606 (`refuseUnknownQueryParams`, `DATA_RECORD_READ_PARAMS`). Measured in #26816's two-host parity rig at `f17981e56a`: REST 400, dispatcher 200.

**Why it matters.** A typo in a query parameter (`?selct=name`) is silently ignored on one host and refused on the other, so a client gets every column and no hint. The two hosts disagree on one input, which is the transport-split class this lane keeps closing.

**Wanted.** The dispatcher's by-id read refuses an unknown query parameter with the same status, code and sentence as RestServer, reading the same declared parameter set, not a second copy. Pin it in the parity rig #26895 adds (`data-record-read-status-parity.test.ts`). Check whether the dispatcher's other `/data` routes drop unknown parameters the same way, and list them.

**Clause-②:** the dev measures it (likely `no (narrowing)`: a request that answered 200 now refuses). **Metadata-protocol:** none expected.
